title: Chronological Outline of Scripture Prophecy
subtitle: A collapsible timeline of 1st, 2nd, and 3rd order events, each connected to the scriptures that describe it.
hint: Use the buttons above the chart to expand or collapse the outline. Hover an event or a scripture to read the description and verses. On a phone, tap to keep the popup open.
laterDecision: Look at event popups and decide whether verse text should sit in an expand/collapse under the description instead of always showing.
dotsNote: The left column is the outline. Reorder objects in data/prophetic-events.json to rearrange it. Verse text is looked up from data/scriptures.json. Collapsing an outline level also hides scriptures that are only cited by hidden events.
footnote: First draft from the chronological outline. The left rail is sequential with millennial tick marks interpolated from 1st-order dates, not a fully proportional scale. Bible verses are the public-domain King James text. Restoration verses are the official LDS text for the passages cited on this chart.
